# Kunasai's Year Abroad

In its first year, the Vento government met the Arennian ambassador, the Zharani envoy and the President of Arenza, and received a cold letter from Mondrath. Diplomats in the capital say Kunasai has not yet chosen a side. Both large powers expect it to choose next year.
